errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the range for the light gray bars. The maximum value, seen in the bar for category 3, is approximately 71, not 70.8 as stated.

The description significantly exaggerates the range of the dark gray bars. The actual values are tightly clustered around 75 (approximately 74.8 to 75.2), but the description claims a much wider range from 74.5 to 76, which misrepresents the stability of the results shown in the chart.
